craft_notes: Sthāyin: discipline. Sanskrit-first: Mādhavakula named. Rows: 2. Close: all. Rejected: universalizing — killed: school rule. Read aloud: forbidding cadence.

lines: No rice, no tears for ours.
l4.sanskrit_cite: uktaṃ śrīmādhavakule śāsanastho mṛteṣvapi | piṇḍapātodakāsrvādi laukikaṃ parivarjayet
